Belgian athletes — scoring breakdown

Every World Triathlon ranking counts an athlete's best 6 results from the last ~52 weeks ("Current") plus their best 6 from the 52 weeks before that ("Previous") — 12 results max. Click an athlete to see every race and the exact score they'd need to beat to bump a result out. A period with fewer than 6 used has no threshold yet — any new counted result adds straight to their total.

Roster scope: Belgian athletes currently ranked in the World Top 400 (Men/Women separately) who have raced at least once in the last 12 months. Athletes who drop out of the Top 400 or go 12+ months without a race are treated as inactive/retired and removed automatically each week — no manual list to maintain.

Athlete deep dive

Pick a Belgian athlete to see, for every upcoming competition on the calendar right now, an estimate of how they'd likely score there — and right next to it, the exact score they'd need to beat in the relevant World Ranking scoring period to actually improve their total. Same underlying model as Opportunity Scoring, just organized around one athlete at a time.

Squad leaderboard — best opportunity per athlete

Every tracked Belgian athlete, ranked by the single biggest scoring opportunity currently on their calendar. This is the quick "who should we prioritize sending where" view for the whole squad — for the full, filterable list of every opportunity for every athlete, use Opportunity Scoring instead.

Top single opportunities, squad-wide

The single biggest point-scoring opportunities across the whole squad right now, regardless of athlete — useful for spotting which upcoming races offer the biggest swings. Capped at 2 per athlete so one athlete's cluster of similar races doesn't crowd out the rest of the squad.

Upcoming Elite start lists

World Triathlon opens the initial start list ~32 days before an event, allows National Federation substitutions until ~30 days out, and finalizes invitations ~28 days out. This scans every upcoming Elite Men / Elite Women program currently listed and flags any Belgian entries. An event showing "Field: 0" hasn't had its start list published yet — check back as it gets closer.

Staging tab — for review. This reworks Opportunity Scoring per Ed's 2026-08-10 request: a 12-week calendar horizon (up from ~5 weeks), a stricter eligible tier list (European Continental Championships, WTCS incl. Championship Finals, World Cup, ETU Cups & Premium Cups, U23 World Championships, Junior World Championships — sourced from World Triathlon's own event category data, not just title text), and an expected-points model that averages an athlete's own results once they have 2+ prior races in a tier, showing the average Weighted Performance Index of the races that estimate is built on. World Triathlon plans to rename WTCS → T50 and World Cup → Challenger Series starting in 2027; both the official-category and title-text matching already recognize either name, but this hasn't been tested against real 2027 data yet. Once reviewed, this will move into the Athlete Focus tab (as "upcoming scoring opportunities", sortable by date/tier/gain/confidence) and the old Opportunity Scoring / Best Opportunities tabs will be retired.

Staging tab — for review. Tracks every Belgian athlete on the two LA28 qualification pathways: the Individual Olympic Ranking (21 places, best 12 scores over two one-year periods) and the Mixed Relay Olympic Ranking (16 places via ranking, plus World-Champion and other pathways). Modeled on tridata.live/la28. Data is a snapshot of the official World Triathlon Olympic Qualification Rankings — not part of the standard update run.

How LA28 qualification works + assumptions behind the projections

Individual Olympic Ranking — Belgians

Biggest threats (ranks 12–21)

Full field, leg-by-leg splits for every race any currently-tracked Belgian athlete has competed in — one sub-dashboard per competition, one table per Elite Men / Elite Women program. Detail tables show % behind both the fastest split in that field and the field average for swim and run (average uses a blue→red diverging scale: blue means faster than average, red means slower), and % behind the winner's time for finish — the same "vs fastest" convention as the topsport manager's existing results sheet. Belgian athletes are bolded. Click a column header to sort.

Belgian results overview

Every Belgian result across all indexed races, filterable by race tier and athlete. Weighted Weighted Performance Index is joined in from the Weighted Performance Index tab where that race has been indexed there.

"Δ" is the official rank change since World Triathlon's previous published update; "NEW" marks athletes appearing in this ranking for the first time.
